_comment: Single source of truth for apps on dnnr.us. 'ai' = short badge label and 'ai_story' = one-line description of the real AI feature (set only for apps that have one). 'featured' = shown in Selected work on the home page. Edit, then run: python3 _src/build.py

apps.name: TJ Near & Hot
apps.tagline: The Trader Joe's finds shoppers love, at the store near you.
apps.ai_story: An AI discovery engine: vector-embedding semantic search understands what shoppers mean, while LLM-powered trust & safety moderates community posts and photos.
apps.description: TJ Near & Hot helps Trader Joe's shoppers find a store nearby, see the grocery finds the community is buzzing about, and build a shopping list. Shoppers swap picks, reviews, and recipes with other fans. It is an independent app and is not affiliated with Trader Joe's.

apps.name: What to Eat
apps.tagline: Point your camera at any menu and see what every dish really is.
apps.ai_story: Multimodal vision-language AI reads a photo of a menu in any language, identifies every dish, and explains it with real photos in seconds.
apps.description: What to Eat turns one photo of a foreign restaurant menu into something you can order from. It finds the dishes on the menu, explains them in your language, and shows real photos so you know what's coming.
highlights: Menu recognition from a single photo

apps.name: AutoMiles
apps.tagline: Every drive logged automatically. No monthly cap, no paywall.
apps.description: AutoMiles automatically detects and logs every drive for mileage tracking, with no monthly cap, subscription, or paywall. Your trips stay on your device.
apps.ai_story: Context-aware trip intelligence detects every drive in the background and infers its purpose from your routes and tagged places, so the mileage log writes itself.

apps.name: StampRescue
apps.tagline: National park stamps nearby, and a park journal that fills itself.
apps.description: StampRescue finds national parks, monuments, and passport stamp stations near you, and turns the photos you already took into a record of every park you've visited.
highlights: Park history from your photos, on device
apps.ai_story: Privacy-first, on-device intelligence mines the location and time data in your photo library to reconstruct every park you've visited, with no uploads, and connects travelers through a location-based community.

apps.name: Golf Passport
apps.tagline: Find courses anywhere and let your rounds log themselves.
apps.description: Golf Passport finds golf courses almost anywhere in the world and turns the photos you already took into a record of every course you've played.
highlights: Rounds logged from your photos, on device
apps.ai_story: Privacy-first, on-device intelligence reconstructs every course you've played from the location data in your photos, with no uploads, and connects golfers through a course-by-course community.

apps.name: Charge&Grab
apps.tagline: See the food, coffee, and restrooms near each Supercharger.
apps.description: Charge&Grab finds Superchargers near you or along your route and shows which ones have food, coffee, groceries, and restrooms within an easy walk.
highlights: Chargers near you or on your route
Food and coffee within walking distance
apps.ai_story: An AI data pipeline aggregates and structures live place data around every Supercharger, turning scattered listings into instant, walkable recommendations.

apps.name: Swing Like Pro
apps.tagline: Compare your golf swing side by side with the pros.
apps.ai_story: On-device computer vision tracks body pose frame by frame and compares your swing with a pro's in 3D, with no sensors and no uploads.
apps.description: Swing Like Pro turns a phone video of your golf swing into a side-by-side lesson with a pro, including a 3D view you can rotate. Your video is analyzed privately on your device.

apps.name: Time Zone Alarm
apps.tagline: Set an alarm on another city's clock. No mental math.
apps.ai_story: Natural-language AI turns a casual phrase into the right city and time zone, powering alarms that follow any clock in the world.
apps.description: Time Zone Alarm sets alarms on another city's clock. Pick the city and the time there, and your phone rings at the right moment where you are.
highlights: Alarms pegged to any time zone

apps.name: BapMap
apps.tagline: Know exactly what to order at Korean restaurants.
apps.ai_story: Multilingual LLMs translate and moderate community content across four languages, turning a local food guide into a global one.
apps.description: BapMap helps you decide what to order at Korean restaurants, with curated restaurants, signature dishes, and practical ordering tips across major U.S. metro areas.

apps.name: Wagyu Beef Finder
apps.tagline: Find stores and butchers that carry wagyu near you.
apps.description: Wagyu Beef Finder helps you find stores, butchers, and specialty markets near you that may carry wagyu beef, with a map and a distance-sorted list.
apps.ai_story: An AI data pipeline gathers and normalizes retailer data nationwide, turning a hard-to-find product into a searchable map.

apps.name: Secret Menu for Super Duper
apps.tagline: A fan-made guide to favorites and off-menu burger combos.
apps.description: Secret Menu for Super Duper is an unofficial fan-made guide to menu favorites and off-menu inspired burger combinations, where fans can share their own combos. It is not affiliated with Super Duper Burgers.
apps.ai_story: LLM-powered trust & safety automatically reviews every fan submission and comment, keeping a user-generated menu helpful and clean.

apps.name: Snap & Shake
apps.tagline: Snap your ingredients and get a cocktail you can make tonight.
apps.ai_story: Multimodal AI recognizes bottles and ingredients from a single photo and generates cocktail recipes tailored to what you have.
apps.description: Snap & Shake turns a photo of the bottles and ingredients you have into cocktail recipes you can make at home.
highlights: Ideas from what you already have

apps.name: Targeted Resume AI
apps.tagline: Tailor your resume to each job post in minutes.
apps.ai_story: Generative AI parses any job post, as text, a link, or a screenshot, and rewrites your resume to match what the employer is looking for.
apps.description: Targeted Resume AI reads a job post, understands what the employer is looking for, and helps tailor your resume to match.
highlights: Paste text, a link, or a screenshot

apps.name: Academic CV AI
apps.tagline: Tailor your CV and statement for every grad program.
apps.ai_story: Search-grounded generative AI researches each graduate program on the web and tailors your CV and statement of purpose to it.
apps.description: Academic CV AI helps graduate school applicants tailor their CV and statement of purpose to each master's or PhD program.
